/-- **The line `ℜs = −1/2`**, general smoothing, `χ`. -/
theorem norm_integral_hIntG_le {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hχ1 : χ ≠ 1) {φ : ℝ → ℂ} {Kv θv : ℝ} (hθv : 0 < θv) (hKv : 0 ≤ Kv)
    (hv : ∀ y : ℝ, ‖mellin φ (((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I)‖ ≤ Kv * Real.exp (-(θv * |y|)))
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    ‖∫ y : ℝ, hIntG χ φ x (((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I)‖ ≤ x ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ) * VgL (DN N) Kv θv := by
  set c₁ := 2 / Real.log 2 + 4.8 with hc₁
  have hc₁0 : 0 ≤ c₁ := by have := Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) < 2); positivity
  have hD : 0 ≤ DN N + 37 := by linarith [DN_nonneg N]
  set g : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => x ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ) * Kv * c₁ *
    ((DN N + 37) * Real.exp (-(θv * |y|)) + 2.6 * (|y| * Real.exp (-(θv * |y|)))) with hg
  have hgi : Integrable g :=
    (((integrable_exp_neg_abs hθv).const_mul (DN N + 37)).add
      ((integrable_abs_mul_exp hθv).const_mul 2.6)).const_mul _
  have hpt : ∀ y : ℝ, ‖hIntG χ φ x (((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I)‖ ≤ g y := by
    intro y
    set s : ℂ := ((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I with hs
    have hsre : s.re = -1 / 2 := by simp [hs]
    rw [hIntG, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_cpow_x hx, hsre]
    have hL := norm_logDeriv_L_left hχ hχ1 y
    have hLB := LB_le_linear (N := N) y
    have hL' : ‖logDeriv χ.LFunction s‖ ≤ c₁ * (DN N + 37 + 2.6 * |y|) := by
      refine hL.trans ?_
      have e : Real.log (BT N y / 0.355) / Real.log 2 / (1 / 2) + 4.8 * Real.log (BT N y / 0.355) =
          c₁ * Real.log (BT N y / 0.355) := by rw [hc₁]; ring
      rw [e]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLB hc₁0
    have hGs := hv y
    have hxp : 0 ≤ x ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hx.le _
    have e2 : x ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) = x ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ) := by norm_num
    calc ‖logDeriv χ.LFunction s‖ * (‖mellin φ s‖ * x ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ))
        ≤ (c₁ * (DN N + 37 + 2.6 * |y|)) * (Kv * Real.exp (-(θv * |y|)) * x ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ)) :=
          mul_le_mul hL' (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hGs hxp) (by positivity) (by positivity)
      _ = g y := by rw [hg, e2]; ring
  refine (norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hgi (Eventually.of_forall hpt)).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  rw [hg, integral_const_mul, integral_add ((integrable_exp_neg_abs hθv).const_mul _)
    ((integrable_abs_mul_exp hθv).const_mul _), integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul,
    integral_exp_neg_mul_abs hθv, integral_abs_mul_exp_neg_mul_abs hθv]
  unfold VgL; rw [← hc₁]; ring

proof_context.conclusion: For primitive $\chi\ne1$ and a smoothing with $|M(-1/2+iy)|\le K_v e^{-\theta_v|y|}$, the line integral on $\Re s=-1/2$ is at most $x^{-1/2}\,\mathrm{VgL}(D_N,K_v,\theta_v)$, using the Landau-based pointwise bound on $L'/L$.

/-- **`L'/L` on the line `ℜs = −1/2`**: `|L'/L(−1/2 + iy)| ≤ (2/log 2 + 4.8) log(B_y/0.355)`. -/
theorem norm_logDeriv_L_left {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hχ1 : χ ≠ 1) (y : ℝ) :
    ‖logDeriv χ.LFunction (((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I)‖ ≤
      Real.log (BT N y / 0.355) / Real.log 2 / (1 / 2) + 4.8 * Real.log (BT N y / 0.355) := by
  set z : ℂ := ((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I with hz
  have hzc : z ∈ Metric.closedBall (2 + y * I) (10 / 4) := by
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, hz]
    have : ((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I - (2 + y * I) = ((-5 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [this, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]; norm_num
  have hLz : χ.LFunction z ≠ 0 := LFunction_ne_zero_strip hχ hχ1 (by simp [hz]; norm_num)
    (by simp [hz]; norm_num)
  refine norm_logDeriv_L_le hχ hχ1 hzc (by norm_num) (fun u hu => ?_) hLz
  have hLu : χ.LFunction u = 0 := by
    have hf := DirichletCharacter.differentiable_LFunction hχ1
    obtain ⟨hur, hu0⟩ := mem_zerosIn hu
    have huR : u ∈ Metric.closedBall (2 + y * I) 10 := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]; linarith
    rw [divB, MeromorphicOn.AnalyticOnNhd.divisor_apply
      (fun z _ => hf.analyticAt z : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ χ.LFunction (Metric.closedBall _ 10)) huR] at hu0
    by_contra hne
    exact hu0 (by rw [(hf.analyticAt u).analyticOrderAt_eq_zero.2 hne]; simp)
  have hre : u.re ≤ -1 ∨ 0 ≤ u.re := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    exact LFunction_ne_zero_strip hχ hχ1 hcon.1 hcon.2 hLu
  have := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (z - u)
  have hzre : z.re = -1 / 2 := by simp [hz]
  rw [Complex.sub_re, hzre] at this
  rcases hre with h | h
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)] at this; linarith
  · rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)] at this; linarith

proof_context.conclusion: Pointwise bound on $|L'/L|$ for $\Re s=-1/2$ by Landau's lemma (linear in $|y|$ via $\log B_T$), not via the functional equation and digamma.
